name: STS2 LAN Co-op
author: STS2 LAN Co-op contributors
description: Native-style Steam/LAN menus, saved-role takeover and Quick SL. Solo players and LAN hosts choose to retain, retry or delete a defeated standard run; final victory and confirmed abandon retire its continuation saves. One DLL for v0.107.1/v0.111.0; all peers need the same game and mod versions. Android mod installation remains manual.
